text:
maria_sales: FYI Acme verbally agreed to a deal that can hit ~5k QPS during campaign peaks. They need reserved GPU floor + autoscale and a preheat/runway plan in the SOW. Can eng/ops price and list failure modes?

dan_engineer: Quick clarifying Qs: request mix and avg tokens?

maria_sales: Presales sheet: 70% chat (avg 250 tokens), 30% embeddings (single vector). Burst pattern: 60s spikes every ~10 minutes.

dan_engineer: Back-of-envelope: 5k QPS * 0.7 = 3500 chat qps * 250 tokens = 875k tokens/sec. Our quantized baseline is ~60k tokens/s per T4-equivalent GPU -> ~15 GPUs. Embeds add concurrency but low token cost.

leo_sre: That matches our sims. For safety propose reserved_floor=12, autoscale to 24, AZ spread, spot tolerance.

ashley_pm: They want 99.9% and p95 <= 400ms. Can 12+autoscale meet that?

dan_engineer: 12 at peak risks queueing; to keep p95 low need lower utilization or KV preheat and stricter batching. Options: raise floor to 16 or route noncritical embed traffic to burst/spot.

leo_sre: I'll add a scheduled KV warmup preheat. infra-bot: enqueue preheat job.

infra-bot: job enqueued job_id=preheat-ACME-1730000000 targets=kv-warm,model-cache,probe-rps

maria_sales: Dan please draft autoscale policy + cost delta floor=12 vs 16 for SOW.

dan_engineer: Draft autoscale snippet: 
```
autoscale_policy: |
  min_replicas: 12
  max_replicas: 24
  scale_metric: "tokens_per_second"
  target_util_pct: 65
  cooldown_secs: 90
  preheat_window_secs: 300
  burst_pool: true
```
Cost note: floor=12 => lower reserved cost but higher autoscale burn (~+40% peak). floor=16 => higher reserved cost, ~20% less autoscale usage. I'll add exact $ in a spreadsheet by EOD.

ashley_pm: Also include legal/security failure modes: AZ eviction -> fallback to smaller quantized model to preserve latency at cost of quality. Spell out RTO and expected quality delta.

dan_engineer: Ran a quick sim: `rps-sim --qps 5000 --mix chat:0.7,embed:0.3 --avg-tokens 250 --p95-target 400` showed queue spikes at 12 GPUs. Sharing sim notes in the deck.

leo_sre: Ops checklist: (1) confirm AZ spread and placement groups; (2) preheat job + verification; (3) fallback model validation; (4) synthetic smoke during next maintenance window. I'll author a runbook.

maria_sales: Action items: Dan -> spreadsheet & refined autoscale config; Leo -> runbook + schedule preheat proof; Ashley -> legal failure-mode text. Bringing in account exec for SOW signoff. :thumbsup:

leo_sre: Ack. Creating runbook now and will ping when ready.

dan_engineer: I'll share numbers/spreadsheet today.

maria_sales: Thanks team, keeping this short for exec review.
